title: Curse of the Empty Lord (miniquest)
start: Talk to the mysterious ghost (Valdez) near Glarial's tombstone (north-west of the Fishing Guild), while wearing a ring of visibility and a way to speak with ghosts.

items.t: Ghostspeak amulet or cramulet or hard Morytania achievements completed

recommended.t: 3-5 energy potions or an explorer's ring
Weapons and armour to defeat some enemies which are aggressive in the Wilderness.

steps.t: Make sure you are wearing your ring of visibility and your ghostspeak amulet.
Speak to the Mysterious ghost near Glarial's tombstone northwest of the Fishing Guild. [Chat: Accept]
This ghost will give you one of three clues which determine your entire route, which we will label Sequence 1, 2, and 3:

sub.t: Sequence 1 - He mentions pirates and a shipwreck.
Sequence 2 - He mentions the thief being north-east of there.
Sequence 3 - He mentions the thief being south-east of there.

steps.t: Talk to mysterious ghost (Rennard) in the location given in the table above to receive ghostly gloves. [Chat: 1 Tell me your story]
Talk to mysterious ghost (Kharrim) in the location given in the table above to receive ghostly boots. [Chat: 1 Tell me your story]
Talk to mysterious ghost (Lennissa) in the location given in the table above to receive ghostly robe bottom. [Chat: 1 Tell me your story]
Talk to mysterious ghost (Dhalak) in the location given in the table above to receive ghostly hood. [Chat: 1 Tell me your story]
Talk to mysterious ghost (Viggora) in the location given in the table above to receive ghostly cloak. [Chat: 1 Tell me your story]
